decision.title: Order.payment as one typed object, not a union
decision.question: Order.payment is a card or a bank account. Map it inline as one typed object (type, last4, brand, iban), or as a union that a field-level connector re-fetches through GET /orders/{orderId}?

choices.label: one object type Lumen_Books_Payment {type, last4, brand, iban}, mapped inline by every Order connector
union Lumen_Books_CardPayment | Lumen_Books_BankPayment on a field-level connector, one extra GET /orders/{orderId} per order

resolution.note: At connect/v0.4 a union maps only at a connector's own return type, so the union needs one extra request per order, and reconcile and source coverage then read payment as unmapped on all four Order operations and the re-fetch as an undeclared relationship field. The object keeps every field the API sends (D-a39c6a: expose last4, brand and iban), typed; type tells the caller which fields apply. Replaces finding F-lr3c96. Reopen to choose the union.
resolution.decision: Lumen_Books_Order.payment is Lumen_Books_Payment {type: Lumen_Books_PaymentType (card|bank), last4, brand, iban}, mapped inline as payment { type last4 brand iban }.
